status: isolated provisional two-feed/two-ground brush connection study; not installed or accepted

ford-pmgr-starter-exploded.reviewed: Applicable factory exploded image distinguishes the brush assembly, four springs, brush plate screws and external connector. It does not identify individual brush polarity or manufacturing clocking.

ford-pmgr-brush-connector-comparison.reviewed: Primary Ford1994Mustang PMGR-family service text identifies the positive brush connector at solenoid M and a black grommet in the starter frame. Family architecture comparison only, not F150 installed coordinates or dimensions.

jn-pmgr-brush-holder-comparison.reviewed: Both photographs inspected directly: four carbon brushes, two braid paths entering the insulated frame grommet/common external eyelet, and two braid paths joining the opposite metal ground bracket. Two feed/two ground is inferred from visible connections together with Ford's identification of the external connector as positive. No polarity stamp or angular dimension is visible.

wagner-pmgr-brush-holder-cross-reference.reviewed: Wagner F50-01 lists Lester3223 and J&N151-14005/69-200/E9OZ11061A/B/C with straight eyelet and push-on solenoid connection. It explicitly identifies F50-00 as an alternate; F50-00 lists J&N151-14007/69-201/F3RZ11061A and a left-angled eyelet. The direct-family15114005 photograph therefore strengthens the earlier15114007 alternate comparison. Exact installed brushholder identity is not established.

return: brush end plate and retaining screws
topology.polarity_clocking: Brush1 at +X and brush4 at -Y are assigned positive; brush2 at +Y and brush3 at -X are assigned ground. These are adjacent pairs in the retained provisional90degree brush layout, not a measured production angle or polarity map.

construction_assumptions.grommet: Separate flanged dielectric body surrounds the jacket through a provisional frame bore. All grommet dimensions and the opening station are assumptions.
construction_assumptions.ground_bridge: One provisional annular metal bridge with two retaining-screw pads sits between the insulating carrier and end plate. Photo supports a common ground bracket, not this ring profile, pad construction or two-pad attachment arrangement.
construction_assumptions.terminations: Pigtails are trimmed to face-contact interfaces at brushes and common conductors. No positive-volume overlap or invented aggregate-winding node is permitted.

limits: Existing accepted starter and coil-wiring modules remain untouched.
Lead gauge, ampacity, braiding, insulation materials, brush wear travel, elastic lead motion and thermal durability are not simulated.
Existing aggregate armature winding packets and commutator subdivision do not form a solved electrical circuit; the new feed/return does not establish complete starter electrical continuity.
No source-derived production fit, current rating, calibrated starting behavior or live electrical test procedure is claimed.
